_comment: NX-035 repo1 append-only: scripts/deploy/rest_server_data_host.sh on DATA_HOST (owner, root, confirmed in person; NX-035-file-backup.md §6.5). Copy to a private 0600 root file and fill in. stage_env is the deployed private stage.env (APP_HOST_ADDR, DATA_HOST_ADDR). files_repo_path is the file backup's own repository (L6 F1: never the journal's): created for nexloop-backup and initialised with the files<TAB>password line when absent; journal_repo_path is the restore journal's repository, only to check the two are apart; restic is DATA_HOST's restic binary (init and cat config run as nexloop-backup). rest_server_archive is a root-owned copy of the official archive versions.lock.json names (size and sha256 recorded there): copy the downloaded file first, install -o root -g root -m 0644 <download> /root/nexloop-tools/<archive name>. tls_cert_file / tls_key_file: issue_certs.py server --ca-dir <CA_DIR> --out <DIR> --name rest-server --san IP:<DATA_HOST_ADDR> on the management machine, then the .chain.crt and the .key (a 0600 file) copied here. max_size_bytes: rest-server --max-size, about three times the repository's size today. Nothing secret is in this file: the htpasswd password (rest<TAB>) and the files repository's restic password (files<TAB>) come on stdin. Optional trusted_owner: the deployment user's name, set explicitly when it owns /srv/nexloop (stage: 751) - root-equivalent on this host (NOPASSWD sudo), so its directories may stand above what the installer checks; what the installer creates stays root's (NX-035-file-backup.md §6.6). Unset: every directory must be root's, as before.
